milestones.description: Uses count_in_box_at_most(kind='block', max_count=8) because brown stained glass does NOT drop as an item when broken without Silk Touch, making inventory_has unreliable. Instead, we verify that at least 1 of the 9 brown_stained_glass blocks in the 3x3 window structure has been removed by checking that the block count in a generous bounding box around the glass wall (spawn-relative) is at most 8 (down from the original 9). The box [-4,-1,0] to [4,6,6] generously encloses the glass at x=[-1,1], y=[1,3], z=3 with ample margin.
